title: I Finally Fixed My Note-Taking (It Wasn't a Note-Taking Problem)
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: Turns out I didn't have a note-taking problem. I had a note-managing problem.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies that the core issue was filing and organization, not capture, shifting focus from capture tools to management solutions

quotes.text: You're not betting on a product. You're betting on a file format that's been around for twenty years.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the long-term value of using open standards over proprietary solutions for information management
